content:
Anita: Quick cleanup from the postmortem thread 17. We need a compact action tracker with owners/times for the GPU surge pattern (quota, autoscaler throttles, scheduler tuning, headroom). I sketched actions below 12. Reply with ownership or edits.

Priya: thanks. Can we split into immediate (48h) vs medium (2w) vs longer term?

Anita: yes. Immediate = quota/backstop + paging rule for consecutive throttles. Medium = scheduler eviction/backoff tuning + KV cache warming. Long = headroom modelling + capacity forecasts.

Sam: Ill do immediate quota/backstop. Plan: add a burst-credit namespace with guarded rules and a temp quota uplift for system-critical models. PR by Thu 10:00 PT.

Li: Ill own scheduler changes. I want to try two knobs: reduce pod eviction grace to 90s for preemptible workers and change spread constraints to reduce AZ hotspotting. Ill run canary in staging Wednesday 23:00 PT.

Joel: headroom modelling here. Ill run stochastic traffic replays (24h and 7d patterns) using last 6 weeks. Deliverable: heatmap + recommended safety multiplier. ETA next Mon EOD.

Carlos: Ill add telemetry: emit `rt.autoscaler.throttle` with labels (cluster, node_pool) and add a 1% sample for KV cache warms via header `X-KV-WARM:1`. Need an owner for rollout.

Priya: Ill update runbook and add a compact triage checklist: quotas -> autoscaler events -> node pool fragmentation -> fallback model check -> cache warming. Will add step for rapid rollback if burst-credit misbehaves. ETA Fri morning.

Anita: infra-bot create a tracker and recurring status ping please.

infra-bot: Created tracker INC-4602: "gpu-capacity-postmortem-followthrough" assigned to Sam, Li, Joel, Priya, Carlos. Link: https://tracker.internal/INC-4602. Reminder: weekly sync Wednesday 09:00 PT.

Sam: note on policy matrix: gate burst-credit by customer_tier and model_size. Large-context LLMs -> no burst credit. Small/medium -> limited burst. Ill include examples in the PR.

Li: example kube change Ill test in staging:
```yaml
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
apiVersion: policy/v1
metadata:
  name: model-worker-pdb
spec:
  minAvailable: 1
  maxUnavailable: 25%
```
Also will adjust eviction grace with: `kubectl drain --grace-period=90 --delete-local-data --ignore-daemonsets`.

Carlos: Prom alert draft for autoscaler throttles:
```
expr: sum(increase(rt_autoscaler_throttle_total[10m])) by (cluster) > 3
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
```
Will attach runbook link to alert.

Priya: Ive added two new triage bullets: "check recent node provisioning failures" and "check image-pull/backoff on new nodes". Those were subtle in the original incident.

Anita: owners and dates: Sam -> quota PR Thu 10:00 PT; Li -> scheduler staging canary Wed 23:00 PT, prod canary Thu 02:00 PT if green; Carlos -> telemetry + alert PR Fri EOD; Joel -> headroom sims Mon EOD; Priya -> runbook Fri AM. Ill run weekly rollups until INC-4602 is closed.

Sam: Ill also add a temporary dashboard tile for GPU headroom by AZ and node_pool. That should help on-call visualize fragmentation.

Li: staging canary scheduled. Ill post results and diff of kube configs to INC-4602.

Joel: will include recommended safety multiplier and a simulation notebook link in tracker.

Priya: first status sync scheduled for Friday 09:00 PT. If anything blocks, ping here.

Anita: one last ask 14: can we add a recurring anomaly detection query that looks for burst in scale-outs + cache-miss spikes within a 15m window? That appears to be the recurring pattern.

Carlos: Ill prototype a combined rule: `increase(kv_cache_miss_total[15m]) > 50 and increase(rt_autoscaler_scale_events[15m]) > 20` then flag as "surge-pattern". Ill post sample queries in INC-4602.

infra-bot: Weekly reminder created for INC-4602 every Wed 09:00 PT until status set to resolved.

Anita: thanks all. Appreciated the quick ownership. Well reconvene Friday. :thumbsup:
